standardIntro: Upload a photo for a preliminary Swin Transformer classification and an XAI explanation.
developerIntro: Select classification models, turn segmentation on or off, and compare model results and explanations.
modelNotice: Classification uses the uploaded checkpoints; segmentation uses models or algorithms. The result is not a medical diagnosis.
demoResultNotice: Demo result: these numbers and heatmaps must not be used to assess a skin condition.
defaultPreset: Default preset: Swin + all segmentation methods
standardSettings: Hair is removed automatically before standard analysis; DeepLab then prepares the crop for Swin Transformer.
settingsIntro: The same image will be analyzed by every selected classification model.
removeHairHint: Hair is automatically removed with Black Hat and inpainting before segmentation and classification.
hairEnabledNotice: Hair was removed before segmentation and classification. Existing checkpoints were trained on original photos, so this processing may affect predictions.
sameImageHint: The selected models use the same image and segmentation setting.
dropHint: Drop a photo here or click to select a file (JPG, PNG, WebP).
invalidFile: Select a JPG, PNG, or WebP image.
invalidResponse: The server returned an incomplete analysis result.
comparisonHint: Select a row to see all seven probabilities for that model.
singleResultHint: The selected model result and all seven probabilities appear below.
segmentationComparisonHint: Compare the masks and overlays produced by every segmentation method.
preprocessingResultsHint: Original photo, photo after hair removal, segmentation mask, and the region sent to the classifier.
xaiSupportNotice: XAI uses the selected classifier weights and its processed input image. Integrated Gradients and Occlusion Sensitivity support every model; Grad-CAM supports EfficientNetB0; Attention Rollout, Transformer Attribution, and Transition Attention Maps support ViT/DeiT; Swin CAM shows each final-stage 7×7 cell's contribution to the class logit rather than attention weights.
xaiUnavailable: Skipped {{count}} unsupported model and XAI method combinations.
xaiHint: Select configurations and explanation methods to compare visualizations.
segmentationHint: When on, DeepLabV3+, Otsu, Grad-CAM, U-Net, and SegNet run on the same image. Available model results and all five masks are compared below.
